query: SELECT s.id FROM series s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_sources x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM watchlist_entries x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM read_progress x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mappings x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_sync_overrides x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_conflicts x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_match_blocks x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_history x WHERE x.series_id = s.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_merges x WHERE x.survivor_id = s.id) LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF s SKIP LOCKED
